notes.title: The official Discord server is here !
notes.content:
We are very happy that you are interested in our project ːsteamhappyː
We have a Discord server where you will be able to:
[list]
[*] Communicate directly with the developers
[*] Watch exclusive announcements/teasers
[*] Share feedback and tips to improve the game
[*] Post/view screenshots from the game
[*] Get unique roles
[*] Socialize and have fun
[/list]
To go to the Discord server, click ---> [url=https://discord.gg/kUT7Pa3MBV]DISCORD[/url]

The BackRooms X team is confident: it is your ideas and feedback that will be the basis for the evolution of the project.
Let's push the boundaries of what is possible together!
